short.de: Vergleicht zwei Anteile an denselben Einheiten (gepaarte Ja/Nein-Daten) — nur die Einheiten mit geändertem Ergebnis zählen.
short.en: Compares two proportions on the same units (paired yes/no data) — only units whose result changed count.

en.text: The **McNemar test** checks whether the proportion of an event changes when the **same units** are judged twice, e.g. before and after a measure. The pairs can be counted in a 2×2 table; only the two cells with a changed result carry information:

items: **$H_0$** — both directions are equally likely, i.e. $b = c$ in expectation
